title: Recessional
program_note:
Recessional was commission by Meet the Composer on behalf of the Honeoye Central School.  It was written in March and April, 1993, and is dedicated to Grace Helling, the director of the Honeoye Senior Band, and the Honeoye Central School.

All of the material for this composition is drawn from short compositions written by Honeoye Theory II students.  The introductory and transitional material is based on music by Christian Jackson; the main theme of the first two sections is by Stacey Smoot; counterpoint to the second statement of that theme is based on material by Philip Freivald, which is also used in a development section.  The main theme of the middle section is derived from a work by Ernest Woodward; counterpoint to the third statement of that theme is based on a composition by Patrick Freivald.

The piece is approximately 7’30” in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz

2 May 1993

Rochester, NY
